toegepas.voor: Growwe klere se drade wys duidelik naas gladde vel
toegepas.na: Die drade van growwe klere wys duidelik langs gladde vel
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'naas' is formal for Grade 4 and 'langs' is the everyday word; 'die drade van growwe klere' reads more naturally than the stacked 'se' possessive.
toegepas.fout: 'naas' is a bookish, formal preposition for a Grade 4 reader where the everyday word is 'langs'
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'langs' is the plain spoken word with the same sense of beside, the 'van' possessive reads naturally, no protected wording or neighbour is touched, and the rough-beside-smooth meaning is unchanged.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Lyne wat niemand geteken het nie
laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Die lyn met die rug langs van kop tot tone loop
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Die lyn van kop tot tone met die rug langs loop
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Two stacked phrases before the verb read clumsily; putting 'van kop tot tone' first makes the subject easier to follow.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The reorder still stacks two phrases before the verb, so it is a lateral move rather than an improvement.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Two adjectives before the noun read more naturally than a trailing relative clause.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'n harde vloer wat blink' already reads naturally, so the stacked adjectives are only a different form.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'almal' normally refers to people; 'al drie' fits three pairs of qualities.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'almal' is acceptable for things in Afrikaans, so 'al drie' is a lateral swap.
